digest.component_or_area: outbound type mapping and sync filtering
propositions: Unmapped or undecided syncable types must fail closed at the start of compute_outbound_mutations, before any mutation is built, by validating that every syncable type (TicketType members minus EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES) is decided—mapped or SKIP.

Type map configuration must be resolved per project via effective_type_map and threaded through all three OutboundMapper implementations (Cloud, DC, and shared field mappers) to enable config-driven type remapping at outbound mutation time.

Lossy type collapse (multiple local types mapping to one Jira type) must be annotated with rebar-type: labels during create/update, following symmetric recovery by recover_type_label inbound, enabling round-trip safety without a full reverse map.
Per-project excluded sync types must be computed as the union of built-in EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES and any local types mapped to SKIP, then applied at both the differ loop and the absent-gets consumer.
The rebar-type: prefix must be added to all four internal-label-prefix tuples to prevent user-visible tag leakage and spurious REMOVE mutations.
Unmapped or coerced types must raise MappingConfigError rather than silently defaulting to 'Task', ensuring no runtime drift.
